name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 8 times in 3 visits over 23 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 23 hours starting 2025-09-17, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
